column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 07（i 10541–10630）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
# 10586、10588、10597、10604、10605 的例句改写过（原句是 rose / grew / fell / levelled off / remained stable 这类过去式，
# 应用在句子里找不到原词形），改成了带原词形的说法，见 build_ielts.py 的 EDITED。
10541 § export § The country exports machinery worldwide. § 该国向全球**出口**机械设备。
10542 § factor § Cost is a major factor in decision-making. § 成本是决策中的一个主要**因素**。
10543 § finance § The project was financed by the state. § 该项目由国家**提供资金**。
10544 § formula § There is no simple formula for success. § 成功没有简单的**公式**。
10545 § function § The heart's function is to pump blood. § 心脏的**功能**是泵血。
10546 § identify § Researchers identified several risk factors. § 研究人员**识别**出了几个风险因素。
10547 § income § Higher education raises lifetime income. § 高等教育能提高终身**收入**。
10548 § indicate § The results indicate a clear improvement. § 结果**表明**情况有明显改善。
10549 § individual § Each individual responds differently. § 每个**个体**的反应各不相同。
10550 § interpret § Results must be interpreted with caution. § 对结果必须谨慎**解读**。
10551 § involve § The job involves a lot of travel. § 这份工作**涉及**大量出差。
10552 § issue § Climate change is a global issue. § 气候变化是一个全球性**问题**。
10553 § labour § The industry relies on skilled labour. § 该行业依赖熟练**劳动力**。
10554 § legal § The company faces legal action. § 该公司面临**法律**诉讼。
10555 § legislation § New legislation protects workers' rights. § 新**立法**保护工人的权利。
10556 § major § Education plays a major role in development. § 教育在发展中起着**主要**作用。
10557 § method § The survey used a new research method. § 这项调查采用了一种新的研究**方法**。
10558 § occur § Accidents occur most often at night. § 事故最常**发生**在夜间。
10559 § percent § About 40 percent of students went to university. § 大约**百分之**四十的学生上了大学。
10560 § period § The study covered a ten-year period. § 这项研究覆盖了长达十年的**时期**。
10561 § policy § The new policy affects all schools. § 这项新**政策**影响所有学校。
10562 § principle § The system works on a simple principle. § 这个系统遵循一个简单的**原理**。
10563 § process § Learning is a lifelong process. § 学习是一个终身的**过程**。
10564 § require § The job requires excellent communication skills. § 这份工作**需要**出色的沟通能力。
10565 § research § Recent research challenges this view. § 最近的**研究**对这一观点提出了质疑。
10566 § respond § People respond differently to stress. § 人们对压力的**反应**各不相同。
10567 § role § Parents play a vital role in education. § 家长在教育中起着至关重要的**作用**。
10568 § section § The report is divided into five sections. § 这份报告分为五个**部分**。
10569 § sector § The service sector employs most workers. § **服务业**雇用了大部分工人。
10570 § significant § There was a significant difference between the groups. § 两组之间存在**显著**差异。
10571 § similar § The two studies reached similar conclusions. § 两项研究得出了**相似**的结论。
10572 § source § The report cites reliable sources. § 这份报告引用了可靠的**来源**。
10573 § specific § The policy targets specific groups. § 这项政策针对**特定**群体。
10574 § structure § The essay needs a clear structure. § 这篇文章需要清晰的**结构**。
10575 § theory § The theory explains the observed pattern. § 这一**理论**解释了所观察到的规律。
10576 § vary § Results vary from one region to another. § 各地区的结果**各不相同**。
10577 § hypothesis § The experiment tested the hypothesis. § 这个实验检验了该**假设**。
10578 § infer § We can infer from the data that demand is rising. § 我们可以从数据中**推断**出需求正在上升。
10579 § evaluate § It is important to evaluate the evidence critically. § 批判性地**评估**证据很重要。
10580 § contribute § Several factors contribute to the problem. § 有几个因素**促成**了这个问题。
10581 § demonstrate § The study demonstrates the value of early education. § 这项研究**证明**了早期教育的价值。
10582 § extract § The researchers extracted data from public records. § 研究人员从公共记录中**提取**了数据。
10583 § undergo § The region underwent rapid change. § 该地区**经历**了迅速的变化。
10584 § underlie § Several assumptions underlie the argument. § 这个论点**建立在**几个假设之上。
10585 § utilise § The firm utilises advanced technology. § 这家公司**利用**先进技术。
10586 § rise § Sales are expected to rise sharply in December. § 预计 12 月的销售额将急剧**上升**。
10587 § increase § The number of users increased by 20%. § 用户数量**增加**了 20%。
10588 § grow § The population is projected to grow steadily over the decade. § 预计未来十年人口将稳步**增长**。
10589 § climb § Unemployment climbed to a record high. § 失业率**攀升**至历史最高水平。
10590 § surge § Online sales surged during the holiday season. § 假日期间网络销售额**激增**。
10591 § soar § House prices soared in the 2020s. § 房价在 2020 年代**飙升**。
10592 § rocket § Costs rocketed after the crisis. § 危机之后成本**飞速上升**。
10593 § jump § Profits jumped to a five-year high. § 利润**跃升**至五年来的最高点。
10594 § decrease § Carbon emissions decreased by 10%. § 碳排放量**减少**了 10%。
10595 § decline § Birth rates have declined in many countries. § 许多国家的出生率已经**下降**。
10596 § drop § The price dropped below the forecast. § 价格**下跌**到预测值以下。
10597 § fall § Attendance is likely to fall to its lowest level. § 到场人数很可能**下降**到最低水平。
10598 § plummet § Oil prices plummeted overnight. § 油价一夜之间**暴跌**。
10599 § plunge § Sales plunged by half in one quarter. § 销售额在一个季度内**骤降**了一半。
10600 § dip § The temperature dipped briefly in May. § 五月的气温曾短暂**回落**。
10601 § fluctuate § The exchange rate fluctuated throughout the year. § 汇率全年都在**波动**。
10602 § peak § Demand peaked in summer. § 需求在夏季**达到顶峰**。
10603 § plateau § Growth plateaued after three years. § 三年之后增长**趋于平稳**。
10604 § level off § Unemployment is expected to level off at around 5%. § 预计失业率将**趋于平稳**，维持在 5% 左右。
10605 § remain stable § Prices are expected to remain stable over the period. § 预计价格在此期间将**保持稳定**。
10606 § steady § There was a steady increase in exports. § 出口出现了**稳定**增长。
10607 § gradual § The shift was gradual rather than sudden. § 这种转变是**渐进**的，而不是突然的。
10608 § sharp § A sharp fall followed the announcement. § 公告发布后出现了**急剧**下跌。
10609 § significant § The chart shows a significant upward trend. § 图表显示出**显著**的上升趋势。
10610 § slight § Only a slight decrease was recorded. § 只记录到了**轻微**的下降。
10611 § substantial § Substantial growth occurred in the service sector. § 服务业实现了**可观的**增长。
10612 § dramatic § There was a dramatic rise in online shopping. § 网上购物出现了**骤然**增长。
10613 § upward trend § The graph shows a clear upward trend. § 图表显示出明显的**上升趋势**。
10614 § downward trend § A downward trend is visible after 2015. § 2015 年之后可以看到**下降趋势**。
10615 § account for § Renewables now account for 30% of electricity. § 可再生能源目前**占**电力的 30%。
10616 § constitute § Women constitute 45% of the workforce. § 女性**占**劳动力的 45%。
10617 § comprise § The sample comprises students and teachers. § 样本**由学生和教师组成**。
10618 § proportion § A large proportion of income goes to housing. § 收入中有很大**比例**用于住房。
10619 § percentage § The percentage of graduates rose steadily. § 毕业生的**百分比**稳步上升。
10620 § double § The number of users doubled in two years. § 用户数量在两年内**翻了一番**。
10621 § triple § Investment tripled between 2010 and 2020. § 2010 年到 2020 年间，投资**增至三倍**。
10622 § halve § The workforce was halved during the crisis. § 危机期间劳动力**减少了一半**。
10623 § respectively § Sales were 20 and 30 million respectively. § 销售额**分别**为 2000 万和 3000 万。
10624 § whereas § Urban rents rose, whereas rural rents fell. § 城市租金上涨，**而**农村租金下降。
10625 § compare § Compare the figures for 2020 and 2025. § 请**比较** 2020 年和 2025 年的数据。
10626 § contrast § There is a sharp contrast between the two periods. § 这两个时期形成了鲜明的**对比**。
10627 § overall § Overall, the trend was positive. § **总体上**，趋势是积极的。
10628 § roughly § Roughly half of respondents agreed. § **大约**一半的受访者表示同意。
10629 § approximately § The population is approximately 8 million. § 人口**大约**为 800 万。
10630 § exceed § Exports exceeded imports by a wide margin. § 出口大幅**超过**了进口。
